about.title: About
about.bio: A passionate web developer, I cover the whole production chain: from designing an interface to shipping it, through back-end architecture and mobile release. I enjoy building a polished user experience just as much as structuring a solid API behind it — front end and back end are, to me, two sides of the same craft, never treated as separate concerns.
about.skills.label: Skills
about.skills: Day to day, my stack revolves mostly around TypeScript, Node.js and GraphQL, both on the client and the server. I also handle the DevOps side — infrastructure as code with Terraform, version control and continuous integration with Git, hosting on AWS — all the way to shipping apps on the App Store and Google Play Store.
